description: This file contains selector functions related to Burn-on-Read (BoR) posts in Mattermost, including functions to identify BoR posts, check if a user has revealed content, get expiration timestamps, and determine sender status.

methods.name: isBurnOnReadPost
methods.description: Checks if a post is a Burn-on-Read post based on its type.

methods.name: isThisPostBurnOnReadPost
methods.description: Determines if a given post object is a BoR post.

methods.name: hasUserRevealedBurnOnReadPost
methods.description: Checks if the current user has revealed the content of a BoR post.

methods.name: shouldDisplayConcealedPlaceholder
methods.description: Determines if a concealed placeholder should be shown for a BoR post to the current user.

methods.name: getBurnOnReadPost
methods.description: Retrieves the BoR post object if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: getBurnOnReadPostExpiration
methods.description: Gets the expiration timestamp for a revealed BoR post.

methods.name: isCurrentUserBurnOnReadSender
methods.description: Checks if the current user is the sender of the BoR post.
